relationships.subject: Nogo-A
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, we demonstrated that Nogo-A in DRG neurons promotes the polymerization of microtubules, which enhances the expression of TRPV1 and contributes to the development of inflammatory heat hyperalgesia.

relationships.subject: Nogo-A
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that Nogo-A in DRG neurons inhibits the phosphorylation of CRMP2, which promotes the polymerization of microtubules during inflammatory pain.

relationships.subject: microtubule polymerization
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, we argued that the depolymerization of microtubules caused by KO of Nogo-A results in a reduced expression of TRPV1, which contributes to the analgesic effect in Nogo-A KO animals.

relationships.subject: nocodazole
relationships.evidence_quote: It was found that inhibition of microtubule polymerization with nocodazole could elevate transiently the PWL at 6 h after CFA injection when compared with the control

relationships.subject: Nogo-A
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis demonstrated that knockout of Nogo-A significantly down-regulated the TRPV1 in DRG neurons of rats with CFA injection

key_findings: Nogo-A promotes microtubule polymerization in DRG neurons by suppressing CRMP2 phosphorylation during CFA inflammatory pain.
Microtubule stabilization (paclitaxel) rescues TRPV1 loss in Nogo-A KO; nocodazole attenuates heat hyperalgesia and SNI mechanical pain.
